component: Header search field placeholder (also all input placeholders using --text-3)
explanation: Found during validation, not reported by the owner. Input placeholder text uses --text-3 which measures 3.24:1 on --s2, below the 4.5:1 guideline. No principle or check sets a text contrast floor: CHK-018 covers keyboard focus rings only. This is recorded as a known limitation of guidance 0.1.0.

classification.rationale: The guidance says nothing about text contrast for placeholders and secondary text, so applications built from it can repeat this. It generalizes beyond the Store.
